name: 08103 · Camden, NJ
findings: ZIP 08103 (Camden) has 92 nonprofit organizations. 32 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08103 (Camden) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
28% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 08103 (Camden) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 27 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.
